# PlxNative Player HUD registry

Declarative player layouts for the native Plex client on rooted LG webOS TVs.

- Authoring describes editable source directories, native packaging and preview commands. [Authoring](AUTHORING.md)
- Agent instructions describe the native compiler and artifact-integrity workflow. [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md)
- The generated manifest schema owns package metadata and resources. [Manifest 1.0](schema/manifest/1.0.json)
- The generated HUD schema owns rendering. [HUD 1.0](schema/hud/1.0.json)
- Minimal supplies a complete starting source directory. [Minimal](examples/minimal/)
- Reference supplies inline sections and native menu openers. [Reference](examples/reference/)
- The published `index.json` carries a `serial`; `index.signed` is its Ed25519 signature plus the exact bytes, verified against the two keys in [keys.json](keys.json). Authors do not sign. [Signed index](IMPLEMENTATION.md#signed-index)
- The app's format guide defines supported vocabulary and invariants. [Format guide](https://github.com/GLinnik21/plx-native/blob/main/docs/hud-plugins.md)

Use the oldest compatible SDK pinned in toolchains.json and lint every shipped language.
Treat every finding as requiring correction. Keep JSON condition order and archive hashes intact.
